assessments.reasoning: Section 6.1 expressly enumerates Undefined, Null, Boolean, String, Symbol, Number, BigInt and Object. Its definition applies to values manipulated by an ECMAScript program. Section 6.2 identifies a separate category of algorithmic specification types.

challenge.method: Compare §6.1 and §6.2 and seek extra or merged categories in observable typeof results. Check null and a callable object in a local runtime.
challenge.results: The enumeration has eight language types. The two observable typeof results illustrate why runtime operator labels cannot be substituted for the abstract type list. The local Node.js v24.4.1 diagnostic agreed. Typeof yields object for null, function for a callable object.

limitations: The list is confined to §6.1 language types of the specified edition.
